column1: # TITLE: Platelet miRNA expression in NSCLC patients
# SUMMARY: Gene expression profile of platelets have been explored due to their stability and abundance in plasma. In this study
column2: we try to address the knowledge gap regarding liquid biopsy markers for early detection of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). For that blood samples were collected in two time points
column3: in the presence and absence of NSCLC. Platelets were isolated and miRNA expression evaluated by microarray technique.
